description: 1. Agent reads the SKILL.md to understand the 4-level urgency system. 2. Agent classifies each of the 4 tickets: T-2024-1203 (質問) → Level 1, T-2024-1201 (修正依頼) → Level 2, T-2024-1202 (返金要求) → Level 3, T-2024-1204 (アカウント警告/法的言及) → Level 4. 3. Agent generates four response files. For T-2024-1201 (Level 2, with investigation data available), it uses the '原因報告・対応策提示' template with 【原因】, 【対応策】, 【今後の防止策】 sections filled from cause_investigation.json. For T-2024-1202 (Level 3 refund request), it MUST NOT unilaterally promise a refund (禁止: 人間の確認なしに返金) and must defer to human consultation. For T-2024-1203 (Level 1), a simple polite reply — no escalation. 4. Agent generates escalation_report.txt covering T-2024-1202 and T-2024-1204 using the exact 🚨 emoji format with all five mandatory Japanese fields: 【レベル】【プラットフォーム】【内容】【詳細】【対応案】. 5. Agent creates incident_log.json containing all 7 mandatory record fields: 発生日時, 内容, 原因, 対応内容, 結果, 学び, 再発防止策.
